semantics.source_url: User-facing navigation URL of the archived parent email. It is not an attachment binary locator and must remain unchanged.
semantics.source_entity_id: Stable identity of the attachment: urn:openrag:openarchiver:attachment:<percent-encoded attachment id>.
semantics.attachment_of: Asserted source-native relation from the attachment entity to its archived parent email entity.
semantics.archive_object_id: Stable OpenArchiver attachment id used for internal resolution.
semantics.content_locator: Internal authenticated locator or endpoint. It is never projected as source_url and is internal-metadata-only.
semantics.content_sha256: Full binary SHA-256 used to verify the resolved object and its SHA-derived OpenRAG document_id.
semantics.size_bytes: Expected binary size used as an additional integrity check.

current_compatibility_adapter.source: OpenArchiver connector SQLite registry opened read-only
current_compatibility_adapter.binary_lookup: attachments.storage_path passed to the authenticated internal storage download endpoint
integrity: SHA-derived document_id must match the indexed document_id

future_connector_change.reason: Remove the backfill job's long-term dependency on the connector's private SQLite schema and storage_path representation.
connector_should_emit: parent email source_entity_id through an asserted attachment_of relation
archive timestamps with their distinct source

connector_should_expose_internally.metadata_resolution: An authenticated service endpoint resolving archive_object_id to status, filename, MIME type, size, SHA-256, parent entity ids and a short-lived content capability or streaming endpoint.
connector_should_expose_internally.content_resolution: An authenticated streaming endpoint addressed by archive_object_id, not by source_url or filename.
connector_should_expose_internally.security: Service-to-service only, bounded streaming, no public storage_path, DLS/tenant binding, audit log and immutable archive reads.

migration: Keep source_url pointing to the parent email so existing download/navigation UI remains valid.
Add the internal resolver contract without changing retrieval, ranking or ScopeTraversalPolicy.
Make the backfill client accept both the read-only manifest adapter and the connector resolver API during migration.
Compare API results with the registry manifest on a controlled cohort.
Retire the SQLite adapter only after exact identity, hash and DLS parity are proven.

exposure.parent_mail_source_url: public API only under existing DLS rules
exposure.storage_path_or_content_capability: internal metadata; never model-visible or public
exposure.attachment_metadata: internal by default; explicit projection policy required later
